campaign_id: VLSIT_RISCV_CPU cluster full HDS qualification v1

host.measurement_method: Python 3.12.10; Win32 GlobalMemoryStatusEx for RAM and shutil.disk_usage('C:/') for disk.

limits.simulation_ram_budget_status: memory-limited target; 1040 MiB maximum run-start available-RAM decrease; just below half the earlier 2.04 GiB coverage-build decrease; not yet measured
limits.simulation_ram_max_drop_measurement: Run-start GlobalMemoryStatusEx available bytes minus lowest available bytes sampled by the per-command guard. The 1040 MiB target is below half the earlier 2.04 GiB coverage-build decrease; the 640 MiB, 896 MiB, and 1024 MiB pilots stopped Verilator elaboration at sampled drops of 647 MiB, 916 MiB, and 1029 MiB before C++ generation completed.
limits.ram_guard_admission: User-approved explicit 1 GiB available-RAM start threshold. The independent 1 GiB runtime reserve and 1040 MiB maximum run-start RAM decrease remain enforced. No additional margin is added above the runtime reserve.
limits.output_estimation_method: Proposed 2 GiB physical upper estimate with NTFS compression. Largest measured run so far is cluster_cmo_qualification_v1_002: 2,328,468,022 logical bytes and 600,969,534 stored bytes (compact.exe; 3.9:1). The estimate is over 3x that physical size; remeasure every run.

waveform_policy.planned_signal_scope: No routine full-chip dump; capture only the interface and transaction window needed for a failed scenario rerun.
waveform_policy.planned_time_windows: Targeted failure window around the failing request through terminal response or retirement/trap.
waveform_policy.failure_diagnostic: Preserve the original run and rerun the same configuration and seed with targeted waveform capture.

compression.method: Windows NTFS transparent compression on verification/sim/runs and verification/sim/coverage; bytes remain directly readable and are checked by SHA-256 manifests/catalog.

review.record: User approved the resource-bounded verification plan on 2026-11-17 and then requested a RAM-optimized execution path. Limits remain one concurrent job, one C++ build worker, a 1 GiB hard host reserve, 2 GiB disk stop threshold and 2 GiB per-run stored-output limit. The 640, 896 and 1024 MiB caps stopped TOP elaboration at sampled decreases of 647, 916 and 1029 MiB before C++ generation. The selected 1040 MiB cap is just below half the earlier 2.04 GiB coverage-build decrease. Admission requires 2.14 GiB available RAM (1 GiB reserve + 128 MiB margin + 1040 MiB run budget). The peak target remains unmeasured until a complete guarded run finishes.
